name: Frailty Indices Benchmark for Predicting Adverse Spinal Surgery Outcomes
description: A benchmarking study using automated machine learning to evaluate, deconstruct, and compare multiple frailty indices for predicting adverse outcomes after spinal surgery.
evaluation_method: AUC-ROC and F1 (supplemented by accuracy, calibration metrics, and precision/recall)
reputation: A specialized clinical benchmarking study used within medical informatics and spine-surgery research communities rather than a widely adopted public benchmark.
notes: Clinical, retrospective dataset with relatively small cohorts and potential selection and measurement biases; results sensitive to cohort shifts, missingness, and variations in coding/EMR data; non-LLM benchmark with privacy/data sharing constraints.
